Academic Calendar - Daily Scheduler
script:
today = frappe.utils.today()

marker_only_activities = [
    "Fee Payment Last Date",
    "Attendance Monitoring",
    "Internal Assessment",
    "Semester Examination",
    "Alumni Registration"
]

active_calendars = frappe.get_all("Academic Calendar", filters={"status": ["in", ["Approved", "Active"]]}, fields=["name"])
active_calendar_names = [c.name for c in active_calendars]

if active_calendar_names:
    due_events = frappe.get_all(
        "Academic Calendar Event",
        filters={
            "parent": ["in", active_calendar_names],
            "parenttype": "Academic Calendar",
            "status": "Pending",
            "auto_execute": 1,
            "start_date": ["<=", today]
        },
        fields=["name", "parent", "activity", "start_date", "end_date", "target_doctype", "target_document"]
    )

    for ev in due_events:
        handled = False

        if ev.activity == "Placement Registration Open" and ev.target_doctype == "Placement Drive" and ev.target_document:
            drive = frappe.get_doc("Placement Drive", ev.target_document)
            drive.registration_status = "Open"
            drive.save(ignore_permissions=True)
            handled = True

        elif ev.activity == "Placement Registration Close" and ev.target_doctype == "Placement Drive" and ev.target_document:
            drive = frappe.get_doc("Placement Drive", ev.target_document)
            drive.registration_status = "Closed"
            drive.save(ignore_permissions=True)
            handled = True

        elif ev.activity == "Admission Open" and ev.target_doctype == "Admission Opening" and ev.target_document:
            opening = frappe.get_doc("Admission Opening", ev.target_document)
            opening.status = "Open"
            opening.save(ignore_permissions=True)
            handled = True

        elif ev.activity == "Admission Close" and ev.target_doctype == "Admission Opening" and ev.target_document:
            opening = frappe.get_doc("Admission Opening", ev.target_document)
            opening.status = "Closed"
            opening.save(ignore_permissions=True)
            handled = True

        elif ev.activity == "Course Registration Open" and ev.target_doctype == "Course Registration Window" and ev.target_document:
            window = frappe.get_doc("Course Registration Window", ev.target_document)
            window.status = "Open"
            window.save(ignore_permissions=True)
            handled = True

        elif ev.activity == "Course Registration Close" and ev.target_doctype == "Course Registration Window" and ev.target_document:
            window = frappe.get_doc("Course Registration Window", ev.target_document)
            window.status = "Closed"
            window.save(ignore_permissions=True)
            handled = True

        elif ev.activity == "Promotion" and ev.target_doctype == "Student Promotion" and ev.target_document:
            frappe.form_dict["student_promotion"] = ev.target_document
            frappe.get_doc("Server Script", "promote_students").execute_method()
            handled = True

        elif ev.activity == "Hall Ticket Generation" and ev.target_doctype == "Hall Allocation" and ev.target_document:
            ha = frappe.get_doc("Hall Allocation", ev.target_document)
            generated = 0
            failed = 0
            for row in ha.students:
                frappe.form_dict["hall_allocation"] = ev.target_document
                frappe.form_dict["admission_student"] = row.admission_student
                try:
                    frappe.get_doc("Server Script", "generate_hall_ticket").execute_method()
                    generated = generated + 1
                except Exception:
                    failed = failed + 1
            frappe.log_error(
                title="Academic Calendar - Hall Ticket Generation Summary",
                message="Hall Allocation " + ev.target_document + ": generated=" + str(generated) + ", failed=" + str(failed)
            )
            handled = True

        elif ev.activity == "Result Publication" and ev.target_doctype == "Assessment Plan" and ev.target_document:
            results = frappe.get_all("Assessment Result", filters={"assessment_plan": ev.target_document, "is_published": 0}, fields=["name"])
            published = 0
            failed = 0
            for r in results:
                frappe.form_dict["assessment_result"] = r.name
                try:
                    frappe.get_doc("Server Script", "publish_assessment_result").execute_method()
                    published = published + 1
                except Exception:
                    failed = failed + 1
            frappe.log_error(
                title="Academic Calendar - Result Publication Summary",
                message="Assessment Plan " + ev.target_document + ": published=" + str(published) + ", failed=" + str(failed)
            )
            handled = True

        elif ev.activity in marker_only_activities:
            handled = True

        if handled:
            frappe.db.set_value("Academic Calendar Event", ev.name, "status", "Completed")
        else:
            frappe.log_error(
                title="Academic Calendar - Unhandled Activity",
                message="Event '" + ev.activity + "' on calendar '" + ev.parent + "' (row " + ev.name + ") fired on " + str(ev.start_date) + " but has no automation handler configured yet. It remains Pending."
            )

    upcoming = frappe.get_all(
        "Academic Calendar Event",
        filters={
            "parent": ["in", active_calendar_names],
            "parenttype": "Academic Calendar",
            "status": "Pending",
            "notification_sent": 0
        },
        fields=["name", "parent", "activity", "start_date", "notification_before_days"]
    )

    admins = frappe.get_all("Has Role", filters={"role": "System Manager"}, fields=["parent"])
    admin_users = [a.parent for a in admins]

    for ev in upcoming:
        if ev.notification_before_days and ev.start_date:
            remind_date = frappe.utils.add_days(ev.start_date, -ev.notification_before_days)
            if str(remind_date) == str(today):
                for u in admin_users:
                    frappe.get_doc({
                        "doctype": "Notification Log",
                        "subject": "Upcoming: " + ev.activity + " starts " + str(ev.start_date),
                        "for_user": u,
                        "type": "Alert",
                        "document_type": "Academic Calendar",
                        "document_name": ev.parent
                    }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)
                frappe.db.set_value("Academic Calendar Event", ev.name, "notification_sent", 1)

script:
old_doc = doc.get_doc_before_save()
just_approved = (not old_doc or old_doc.renewal_status != "Approved") and doc.renewal_status == "Approved"

if just_approved:
    if doc.eligibility != "Eligible":
        frappe.throw("Cannot generate new application: Eligibility must be marked 'Eligible' before approving this renewal.")

    if doc.new_application:
        frappe.msgprint("New application already linked to this renewal: " + doc.new_application)
    else:
        prev_app = frappe.get_doc("Scholarship Application", doc.previous_application)
        old_scheme = frappe.get_doc("Scholarship Scheme", prev_app.scheme)

        new_scheme_name = old_scheme.scheme_name + " (" + doc.academic_year + ")"

        if frappe.db.exists("Scholarship Scheme", new_scheme_name):
            new_scheme_name_final = new_scheme_name
        else:
            new_scheme = frappe.get_doc({
                "doctype": "Scholarship Scheme",
                "scheme_name": new_scheme_name,
                "provider": old_scheme.provider,
                "academic_year": doc.academic_year,
                "scholarship_type": old_scheme.scholarship_type,
                "eligibility_criteria": old_scheme.eligibility_criteria,
                "income_limit": old_scheme.income_limit,
                "attendance_requirement": old_scheme.attendance_requirement,
                "amount": old_scheme.amount,
                "status": "Active",
                "renewed_from": old_scheme.name
            })
            new_scheme.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            new_scheme_name_final = new_scheme.name

        new_app = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "Scholarship Application",
            "student": prev_app.student,
            "scheme": new_scheme_name_final,
            "academic_enrollment": prev_app.academic_enrollment,
            "status": "Draft"
        })
        new_app.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

        doc.new_application = new_app.name

        frappe.msgprint("Created scheme " + new_scheme_name_final + " and application " + new_app.name + ".")

Scholarship Payment - Fee Adjustment on Sales Invoice
script:
old_doc = doc.get_doc_before_save()
just_completed = (not old_doc or old_doc.status != "Completed") and doc.status == "Completed"

if just_completed and doc.paid_to == "College (Fee Adjustment)":
    if not doc.sales_invoice:
        frappe.throw("Sales Invoice is required when Paid To is College (Fee Adjustment).")

    already_exists = frappe.db.exists("Payment Entry", {"reference_no": doc.name, "docstatus": 1})
    if already_exists:
        frappe.msgprint("Payment Entry already exists for this scholarship payment: " + already_exists)
    else:
        si = frappe.get_doc("Sales Invoice", doc.sales_invoice)
        outstanding = si.outstanding_amount

        if doc.amount <= outstanding:
            get_payment_entry = frappe.get_attr(
                "erpnext.accounts.doctype.payment_entry.payment_entry.get_payment_entry"
            )
            pe = get_payment_entry("Sales Invoice", doc.sales_invoice)
            pe.mode_of_payment = "Scholarship"
            pe.posting_date = doc.payment_date
            pe.reference_no = doc.name
            pe.reference_date = doc.payment_date
            pe.paid_amount = doc.amount
            pe.received_amount = doc.amount

            for ref in pe.references:
                if ref.reference_name == doc.sales_invoice:
                    ref.allocated_amount = doc.amount

            pe.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            pe.submit()
            frappe.msgprint("Payment Entry " + pe.name + " created and submitted against " + doc.sales_invoice + ".")

        else:
            if not doc.excess_handling:
                frappe.throw(
                    "Scholarship amount (" + str(doc.amount) + ") exceeds the invoice outstanding ("
                    + str(outstanding) + "). This student appears to have already paid. "
                    "Please set Excess Handling to Refund to Student or Credit Next Semester before saving."
                )

            pe = frappe.new_doc("Payment Entry")
            pe.posting_date = doc.payment_date
            pe.party_type = "Customer"
            pe.party = si.customer
            pe.mode_of_payment = "Scholarship"
            pe.reference_no = doc.name
            pe.reference_date = doc.payment_date
            pe.paid_amount = doc.amount
            pe.received_amount = doc.amount

            if doc.excess_handling == "Credit Next Semester":
                pe.payment_type = "Receive"
                pe.paid_to = frappe.db.get_value("Company", si.company, "default_bank_account") or frappe.db.get_value("Account", {"account_type": "Bank", "company": si.company}, "name")
                pe.paid_from = frappe.db.get_value("Company", si.company, "default_receivable_account")
                pe.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
                pe.submit()
                frappe.msgprint(
                    "Payment Entry " + pe.name + " created as an unallocated advance of " + str(doc.amount)
                    + " for " + si.customer + ". It will be available to adjust against the next Sales Invoice."
                )
            else:
                pe.payment_type = "Pay"
                pe.paid_from = frappe.db.get_value("Company", si.company, "default_bank_account") or frappe.db.get_value("Account", {"account_type": "Bank", "company": si.company}, "name")
                pe.paid_to = frappe.db.get_value("Company", si.company, "default_receivable_account")
                pe.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
                pe.submit()
                frappe.msgprint(
                    "Payment Entry " + pe.name + " created recording a refund of " + str(doc.amount)
                    + " owed to " + si.customer + ". Process the actual bank refund outside the system."
                )

script:
doc_name = frappe.form_dict.get("generate_alumni")
gen_doc = frappe.get_doc("Generate Alumni", doc_name)

conditions = ["e.status = 'Completed'"]
values = {}

if gen_doc.filter_program:
    conditions.append("e.program = %(program)s")
    values["program"] = gen_doc.filter_program

if gen_doc.filter_academic_year:
    conditions.append("e.academic_year = %(academic_year)s")
    values["academic_year"] = gen_doc.filter_academic_year

if gen_doc.filter_batch:
    conditions.append("s.batch = %(batch)s")
    values["batch"] = gen_doc.filter_batch

where_clause = " AND ".join(conditions)

query = "SELECT e.name as enrollment, e.student as student, s.student_name as student_name, s.registration_number as registration_number, e.program as program FROM `tabAdmission Program Enrollment` e INNER JOIN `tabAdmission Student` s ON s.name = e.student WHERE " + where_clause + " AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabAlumni` a WHERE a.admission_student = e.name)"

results = frappe.db.sql(query, values, as_dict=True)
frappe.response["message"] = results

script:
# API endpoint to auto-grade an LMS Quiz Submission
import json
submission_name = frappe.form_dict.get("submission")

if not submission_name:
    frappe.response["message"] = {"error": "Quiz Submission ID required"}
else:
    submission = frappe.get_doc("LMS Quiz Submission", submission_name)
    quiz = frappe.get_doc("LMS Quiz", submission.quiz)
    
    # Score calculation
    correct = 0
    total = len(quiz.questions) if quiz.questions else 0
    details = []
    
    for i, q in enumerate(quiz.questions):
        question_data = json.loads(q.question) if isinstance(q.question, str) else q.question
        correct_answer = question_data.get("answer", "") if question_data else ""
        # Extract user answer from LMS Quiz Result child table (selected_option field)
        user_answer = ""
        results_table = submission.get("result") or []
        if i < len(results_table):
            r = results_table[i]
            user_answer = r.get("selected_option") or r.get("answer") or r.get("response") or ""
        
        is_correct = str(user_answer).strip().lower() == str(correct_answer).strip().lower() if correct_answer else False
        if is_correct:
            correct = correct + 1
        details.append({"question_no": i+1, "correct": correct_answer, "user_answer": user_answer, "is_correct": is_correct})
    
    score = (correct / total * 100) if total > 0 else 0
    
    # Save auto-grade result
    grade_result = frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "Auto Grade Result",
        "quiz_submission": submission_name,
        "student": submission.member,
        "quiz": submission.quiz,
        "score": score,
        "total_questions": total,
        "correct_answers": correct,
        "wrong_answers": total - correct,
        "grading_method": "Auto (Exact Match)",
        "grading_details": json.dumps(details)
    })
    grade_result.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()
    
    frappe.response["message"] = {"status": "success", "score": score, "correct": correct, "total": total, "grade_id": grade_result.name}

name: omr_grade_sheet
script:
# API endpoint to grade an OMR answer sheet and persist the result
# Called via: /api/method/omr_grade_sheet?answer_key=OMR-KEY-001&answers=1=A,2=B,3=C&student_name=John%20Doe
import json
answer_key_name = frappe.form_dict.get("answer_key")
student_answers = frappe.form_dict.get("answers")
student_name = frappe.form_dict.get("student_name", "")

if not answer_key_name or not student_answers:
    frappe.response["message"] = {"error": "Answer Key and Student Answers required"}
else:
    key = frappe.get_doc("OMR Answer Key", answer_key_name)
    correct_list = key.correct_answers.split(",")
    student_list = student_answers.split(",")
    
    correct_count = 0
    wrong_count = 0
    total = min(len(correct_list), len(student_list))
    
    for i in range(total):
        c_part = correct_list[i].strip()
        s_part = student_list[i].strip()
        c = c_part.split("=")[1].strip() if "=" in c_part else c_part.strip()
        s = s_part.split("=")[1].strip() if "=" in s_part else s_part.strip()
        if c.upper() == s.upper():
            correct_count += 1
        else:
            wrong_count += 1
    
    score = (correct_count * key.mark_per_correct) - (wrong_count * key.negative_mark)
    score = max(0, score)
    has_passed = 1 if score >= (key.passing_score or 0) else 0
    
    # Persist to OMR Answer Sheet
    sheet = frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "OMR Answer Sheet",
        "answer_key": answer_key_name,
        "student_answers": student_answers,
        "student_name": student_name,
        "total_questions": total,
        "correct_count": correct_count,
        "wrong_count": wrong_count,
        "score": score,
        "passed": has_passed,
        "graded_on": frappe.utils.now_datetime()
    })
    sheet.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()
    
    frappe.response["message"] = {
        "status": "success",
        "total_questions": total,
        "correct": correct_count,
        "wrong": wrong_count,
        "score": score,
        "passing": bool(has_passed),
        "sheet_id": sheet.name
    }
